#!/bin/bash
# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║   COURTNEY HOSTING — Zero-Install Setup        ║
# ║   Downloads latest release from GitHub     ║
# ║   No npm install required.                  ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝

set -e

GITHUB_REPO="mzeeemzimanjejeje/courtney-hosting"
GITHUB_BRANCH="main"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"

echo ""
echo "==> Preparing install directory..."
mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}"
cd "${INSTALL_DIR}"

# Remove existing files but keep the directory
find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

echo "==> Installing dependencies (curl, tar)..."
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl tar 2>/dev/null

echo "==> Downloading COURTNEY HOSTING from GitHub..."
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/archive/refs/heads/${GITHUB_BRANCH}.tar.gz" \
  -o /tmp/anonymiketech.tar.gz

echo "==> Extracting files..."
tar -xzf /tmp/anonymiketech.tar.gz \
  --strip-components=1 \
  -C "${INSTALL_DIR}"

rm -f /tmp/anonymiketech.tar.gz

echo "==> Verifying install..."
if [ ! -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/index.js" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: index.js not found after extraction. Install failed."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/server.mjs" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: server.mjs not found after extraction. Install failed."
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║      COURTNEY HOSTING installed successfully!  ║"
echo "║                                              ║"
echo "║  All environment variables are pre-filled.  ║"
echo "║  Just hit Start — you're ready to go!       ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo ""

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port the platform listens on. Automatically set to the Pterodactyl-allocated port — do not change this.

variables.name: Serve Static Frontend
variables.description: Serve the built React frontend from disk. Must be true.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Main PostgreSQL connection string (users, bots, transactions, etc.).

variables.name: Session Database URL
variables.description: (Optional) Separate PostgreSQL URL for session storage only. Leave blank to use the main DATABASE_URL.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Long random string used to sign session cookies.

variables.name: GitHub OAuth Client ID
variables.description: GitHub OAuth App client ID. Callback: https://hosts.courtneytech.xyz/api/auth/github/callback

variables.name: GitHub OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Secret key for your GitHub OAuth App.

variables.name: Google OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Secret key for your Google OAuth client.

variables.name: Admin Emails
variables.description: Comma-separated email addresses that get admin access at /1admin1

variables.name: Pterodactyl Panel URL
variables.description: Full URL of your Pterodactyl panel where user bots will be hosted.

variables.name: Pterodactyl Application API Key
variables.description: Application API key from Admin → Application API → Create in your Pterodactyl panel.

variables.name: Resend API Key
variables.description: API key from https://resend.com for sending transactional emails.

variables.name: Payflow Account ID
variables.description: (Optional) Payflow/M-Pesa account ID for accepting payments.

variables.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token for GitHub API access.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity. Use info for normal operation, debug for troubleshooting.
